questions.title: Can You Use Someone Else's Club?
questions.question: If you forget your own club, can you use another player's club to hit your ball during a round?

choices.text: No, you can't use someone else's club during a round.
Yes, but only if you are putting.
Yes, but only one time in a round.

questions.explanation: You have to use only your own clubs when you play. You can't take someone else's club to play your shots.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: A stick you use to hit the golf ball.
Playing all the holes on the golf course during one game.

questions.teachingTip: Let children choose 14 clubs for their own golf bag before starting play. Discuss why each player needs to use only their own clubs.
likelyMisconceptions: Thinking it's okay to use a friend's club just once or if you ask nicely.
Believing you can use another player's club just for putting.

questions.title: Borrowing a Club During a Round

choices.text: No, you are not allowed to borrow clubs from other players during a round
Yes, as long as you ask politely
Yes, but only once per round
